basic_info.description: Welcome to 1124 Judah Street, a beautifully remodeled single-family home in San Francisco's coveted Inner Sunset neighborhood. This stunning residence features a thoughtfully designed layout with two spacious bedrooms, a modern bathroom, a formal dining room, a sunlit living area, and a sleek kitchen equipped with Energy Star-rated stainless steel appliances and designer-grade cabinets on the upper floor. The lower level offers an additional bedroom, a contemporary bathroom, a media room, and a stylish wet bar perfect for entertaining. Recent upgrades include new electrical and plumbing systems, a brand-new furnace for enhanced comfort and efficiency, and a brand-new roof for added durability and peace of mind. High-quality waterproof and scratch-resistant flooring throughout adds both durability and elegance. Step outside to a spacious, newly remodeled backyard an ideal retreat for relaxation or gatherings. Located just moments from Golden Gate Park, an array of local restaurants, and convenient public transportation via the N Judah Muni line, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and urban convenience. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a move-in-ready gem in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
